purpose: v027 engine braking restoration, decel overrun pop evaluation, and SCG-1 8% WGDC boost response validation

tune.installation_evidence: Flashed by owner; active road drive in progress; owner visual screenshots verified before flash

changes_since_previous_run: Relative to v026: lowered DFCO enable VSS from 35 to 18 mph ([ECM] 44491); shortened DFCO delay from 3.0s to 1.0s ([ECM] 44496); retarded warm decel spark above 3k RPM to 0 to -2 deg ATDC ([ECM] 44605); trimmed dashpot pre-position air at 3,150 and 4,150 RPM ([ECM] 32988). Innovate SCG-1 WGDC stepped from 6% to 8%.

profile.filename: profiles/2004 Focus SVT - V023 Idle Spark Trial.Channels.xml
profile.status: All 18 requested channels required; paired with SCG-1 wideband lambda

conditions.accessories: Standard driving; A/C OFF during pulls

planned_actions: Stage A1: Startup through warm idle; verify clean idle catch and STFT within +-5%
Stage A2: Free-rev dashpot test in neutral; verify smooth return to 950 RPM without stalling
Stage B1: In-gear 2nd/3rd gear decel from 45 mph down to 18 mph; verify DFCO activation and engine braking deceleration torque
Stage B2: Overrun burble evaluation during 1.0s pre-DFCO window above 3,000 RPM
Stage B3: Clutch-in idle catch from road speed; verify zero stalling or severe undershoot (<800 RPM)
Stage C1: Progressive 3rd gear WOT pull with 8% SCG-1 WGDC; verify boost response (~13.5-14.0 psi), wideband lambda (0.73-0.75), and zero knock retard (0.00 deg)
stop_conditions: Wideband lambda > 0.80 (> 11.7 AFR) under boost > 8 psi
Boost spike > 15.0 psi (approaching 16 psi SCG-1 cut)
Engine stall or severe undershoot (< 700 RPM) on clutch-in
Fuel rail pressure collapse (< 35 psi differential)
